answer_1.quote: We test ELVA as a document assistant, we introduce two new datasets, CORD-Instruct and Parsing-Bench.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates structured outputs such as JSON, XML, or Markdown from document images, including summaries of purchased items and detailed captions with extracted text.
